# Phase Two Critique — Twenty Improvements

The Awtsmoos tests every vessel before more light is poured inside;
Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when each beautiful idea survives evidence, restraint, and a skeptical guide.

## Critique of phase one

The first brainstorm correctly widened the possibility space, but it risks inventing infrastructure before tracing existing contracts. It also mixes site-wide aspirations with changes that should only occur on measured failing surfaces. The improved plan must maximize leverage while minimizing parallel foundations.

## Improvements

1. **Existing-first architecture.** Search for shared style and lifecycle primitives before creating any `MerkavaSurface` base class.
2. **Canonical-source rule.** Identify the single source of truth for app/game/API metadata before adding registries.
3. **Public-contract preservation.** Internal Kabbalistic naming must never make external agent APIs harder to guess or document.
4. **Measured UI mutation.** Static risk signals trigger inspection, not automatic rewriting.
5. **Scoped-style proof.** Every candidate stylesheet must be scanned for its selector root and import chain before reuse.
6. **Import graph before consolidation.** Do not consolidate CSS merely because filenames look related; verify actual consumers.
7. **No second token universe.** If active design tokens already exist, extend them locally rather than create competing variables.
8. **Mobile acceptance first.** Define 320×568 and 390×844 containment before aesthetic polish.
9. **Focus contract first-class.** Any retractable menu/drawer must define opener focus, internal traversal, Escape, and focus return.
10. **Stacking context documentation.** Replace arbitrary z-index escalation with local layer tiers only when touching an affected surface.
11. **Motion budget.** Each animation must communicate entry, state change, selection, or hierarchy; decorative perpetual motion is excluded.
12. **Reduced-motion parity.** Reduced motion must preserve visual state, not merely disable all transitions blindly.
13. **Pointer modality separation.** Hover effects belong inside `(hover: hover)` or equivalent where touch behavior would otherwise become sticky.
14. **Data schema before renderer changes.** For agent/cartoon work, define/locate schemas before adding rendering features.
15. **Renderer reuse.** If an existing canvas/SVG/game engine can host cartoon scenes, extend it with adapters rather than duplicate rendering stacks.
16. **Agent bootstrap minimalism.** A machine bootstrap should return capability metadata and next steps, not the entire documentation payload.
17. **Error contracts.** API improvements must include retryability/idempotency semantics because autonomous agents need failure guidance more than prose flourish.
18. **Examples as tests.** Every public quickstart example should be executable or schema-validated so docs cannot silently rot.
19. **Catalog truth before catalog beauty.** Product records must be correct before visual enhancement; no beautiful dead links.
20. **No blanket page injection.** “Improve all pages” should be achieved through verified shared imports plus targeted local modules, never a global stylesheet/script dropped onto every page.
21. **Legacy ceiling protection.** Large files are read for context but new responsibilities move to small modules; touching a legacy monolith requires decomposition, not append-only growth.
22. **Performance budget.** New effects should avoid heavy backdrop/filter use on scrolling mobile surfaces unless profiling proves it acceptable.
23. **Accessibility semantics over div choreography.** Prefer native buttons/details/dialog patterns where support and behavior fit.
24. **DOM-root discipline.** Reusable JS must query beneath its supplied root and must not assume unique global IDs unless that is the existing contract.
25. **Security boundary.** AI-install/bootstrap docs must not encourage credential transport through URLs, logs, or client-visible callback pages.
26. **Version compatibility.** Capability manifests must state protocol/API versions and preserve old clients unless an explicit migration exists.
27. **Test the smallest boundary.** Validate a registry/schema/class independently before browser-level probes.
28. **Runtime screenshots are evidence, not decoration.** Capture before/after only for surfaces actually changed.
29. **Readback is mandatory.** Every full-file write must be reread from disk before being considered complete.
30. **Remaining-work gravity.** Every discovery adds or closes a concrete node in `REMAINING_WORK.md`; completion cannot be inferred from enthusiasm.

## Improved direction

The next pass will discover current shared foundations and the real scene/agent architecture, then choose a narrow set of high-leverage files whose changes can truthfully improve many pages. It will not claim site-wide improvement from a single stylesheet unless import evidence proves that scope.
